public_rationale: He framed the whole sentence as 'it seems inevitable'. That is his impression of where things were heading, with no date and no definition of collapse. In the next paragraph he concedes that OpenAI or Anthropic might still raise money and keep the bubble going 'though not forever'. Funding did continue: $6.6 billion in October 2024 and $40 billion in March 2025 (e1, e2). That sits poorly with 'the funding will not be there'. But scoring a hedged, undated impression as a firm forecast would go beyond his words, so it is not scored.
limitations: An evaluator who read 'the funding will not be there' as a firm near-term prediction could treat e1 and e2 as contradicting it.
